interpretation: One illustrative composition-matched arrangement pair; no training, aggregation label, SASA estimate, or biological performance claim.

selection.exposure_proxy: Number of OTHER complete-backbone residue CAs within neighbor_radius; lower counts are surface-like, not solvent-accessible surface area (SASA).
selection.center_rule: Lowest neighbor count, then observed sequence index, among bottom-quartile counts (ties included), with sufficient patch size and at least two identities.
selection.membership_rule: All complete-backbone residues with CA within patch_radius of center CA.
selection.altloc_rule: Coherent backbone label plus shared blank atoms; most complete, highest summed occupancy, then blank/A/lexical label; duplicate atoms by occupancy/serial/coordinates.

mapping.selected_model_policy: first explicit model, otherwise implicit model
mapping.sequence_basis: observed standard ATOM residue order; no SEQRES or unresolved-residue reconstruction
mapping.heteroatom_policy: HETATM records excluded, including modified amino acids

geometry.policy: Backbone coordinates stored once and shared by both identity assignments; native sidechains are not used or regenerated.
